mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, a.id AS account_id, o.instrument_id, i.ticker AS symbol, o.side, o.quantity, o.limit_price AS price, o.status FROM Orders o JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN Instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE Orders SET status = 'FILLED'::order_status_enum, executed_price = #{executedPrice}, fee_amount = #{feeAmount}, executed_on = now() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'NEW'::order_status_enum
UPDATE Orders SET status = 'REJECTED'::order_status_enum, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, executed_on = now() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'NEW'::order_status_enum
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Trades (order_id, execution_price, execution_quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{executionPrice}, #{executionQuantity})
